facts.text: Service-to-service authentication using Client Credentials Flow is supported from version 20.0 onwards.
Register an application in your Microsoft Entra tenant with a unique name and select account type.
Create a client secret for the registered application with a specified duration.
Grant AdminCenter.ReadWrite.All permission to the registered application for the admin center API.
Go to the admin center and paste the application client ID in the Authorized Microsoft Entra apps page.
AdminCenter.ReadWrite.All permission required for admin center API calls; API.ReadWrite.All and Automation.ReadWrite.All also available.
The admin center API is located at https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com
